name: gitforge
description: Free, open-source desktop Git client (Go + Wails 3, Vue 3, TypeScript) — graph-first alternative to GitKraken with commit graph, branches, staging and real local Git operations.
author: GitForge <justinh_12@protonmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run sync-version -- --check && npm run go:test
scripts.dev:go: vite build && cd go-backend && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 CGO_CFLAGS='-O2 -g -mmacosx-version-min=11.0' CGO_LDFLAGS='-mmacosx-version-min=11.0' go build -o GitForge.app/Contents/MacOS/GitForge . && mkdir -p GitForge.app/Contents/Resources && cp appicon.icns GitForge.app/Contents/Resources/GitForge.icns && codesign --force --sign - GitForge.app && open GitForge.app
scripts.go:build: cd go-backend && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 CGO_CFLAGS='-O2 -g -mmacosx-version-min=11.0' CGO_LDFLAGS='-mmacosx-version-min=11.0' go build -o GitForge.app/Contents/MacOS/GitForge . && mkdir -p GitForge.app/Contents/Resources && cp appicon.icns GitForge.app/Contents/Resources/GitForge.icns && codesign --force --sign - GitForge.app
scripts.go:test: cd go-backend && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 CGO_CFLAGS='-O2 -g -mmacosx-version-min=11.0' CGO_LDFLAGS='-mmacosx-version-min=11.0' go test ./...
scripts.go:vet: cd go-backend && GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.0 CGO_CFLAGS='-O2 -g -mmacosx-version-min=11.0' go vet ./...
